usedFor: Follow Up Boss holds your deals, and Asana receives a project through “Create Project” for each new one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Created” in Follow Up Boss, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new deal gets a project in Asana, so the work after the deal has a home.

watchOut: “Contact Is Updated” fires on every edit, so keep it away from “Create Project” or you get repeats.
